acceptanceCriteria: `scripts\lyrveil.cmd test lint` exits 0 on the repository as it is, and non-zero when a tracked Markdown file has a broken relative link or heading anchor, as a test with a fixture shows.

The documentation checks scan only Git-tracked Markdown, report counts, and fail on an unfinished-work marker, a requirement or acceptance criterion with no trace in docs/traceability.md, a test ID used in the docs but missing from the catalog in docs/testing.md, or a catalog test that no roadmap exit names.

`scripts\lyrveil.cmd test <level>` exits non-zero with a clear message for an unknown level and for a level that has no tests yet: no level reports a pass without running tests.
